title: Per-token affine merge and KV-prefetch scheduler to reduce INT8/FP8 dequant stalls
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: We observed tail latency spikes when mixing INT8 and FP8 model variants with dynamic KV-cache reuse. Root cause traced to microstalling during per-token dequantization when the kernel scheduler switched execution lanes and the KV window prefetcher tripped an extra serialization point. This PR introduces a lightweight per-token affine-merge pass in the kernel pipeline coupled with a windowed KV-prefetch scheduler to coalesce dequant work and remove serialization across microbatches.

What this changes: Adds a new kernel fusion step (affine_merge_pass) that merges the tiny affine rescale + requant (dequant-affine-requant common pattern for smoothquant) into a single vectorized microkernel for INT8/FP8 hybrid paths. The scheduler changes introduce a KV-prefetch window (default 8 tokens) that aligns prefetching with affinity windows from the batcher to avoid cross-lane cache thrash.

Goals: Reduce per-token latency jitter on mixed-precision workloads, improve throughput in small-microbatch scenarios (1-8 tokens), and keep steady-state token/sec at parity or better with prior fused paths.

Design summary: - New pass: affine_merge_pass applied after layout normalization and before attention kernel selection. - Kernel: socalled "affine_merge_v2" implements fused dequant (INT8->FP32), affine scale/bias, and optional requant to FP8 in a single loop with prefetch hints. - Scheduler: kv_window_prefetcher schedules KV reads in aligned windows and defers cross-lane prefetches until the window completes. - Batcher integration: microbatcher includes affinity hints (affinity_id) which scheduler uses to avoid prefetching KV for lanes that will be drained soon. - Configuration: runtime flags (env and per-deployment config) to tune window size and enable/disable fused kernel.

Performance results (internal e2e bench): - Testbed: A100x4, Llama-3-8B variants (fp32 baseline / int8-smoothquant / fp8-heuristic), synthetic chat trace of 12k tokens. - Median latency (1-token microbatch): - baseline: 23.4ms, with this PR: 17.6ms (-24.8%) - P95: baseline 61.0ms -> 38.2ms (-37.4%) - Throughput (tokens/sec steady): baseline 9.8k -> 10.9k (+11.2%) - Cost proxy (GPU utilization): +3% steady util, net decrease in wasted stalls measured by scheduler traces. Regression tests show no quality delta on output when requant path used; we added opt-in param to bypass requant for strict FP8 fidelity.

Backward/compatibility: No API changes to the public inference API. Runtime flags are opt-in; deployments can gate rollout. Default is enabled for dedicated and private clusters with GPU >= Ampere.

Checklist (high level): - [x] Design doc link: Linear ENG-4821 (see linked_linear) - [x] Unit tests for affine_merge_v2 microkernel - [x] Integration tests for KV window alignment - [x] Perf harness run and numbers recorded - [x] Feature-flag gated rollout plan - [x] Observability: added metrics for prefetch_window_misses and affine_merge_fallback_count

Review conversation (high level, chronological):
- Diego Ramirez (reviewer): "Nice consolidation — can we avoid additional memory pressure when vectorizing? Please add explicit checks for register spilling and a fallback to normalized path."
- Author (Maya): "Added runtime heuristics to limit vector width based on reported L1/L2 size; added fallback counter metric for tracing."
- Sofia Patel (perf reviewer): "Benchmarks look good; please add microbench for mixed-precision 4-way batching and verify P95 regression under load."
- Author: "Added 4-way mixed microbatch perf job and included results in PR description. Also added canary rollout instructions."
- Carlos Alvarez (SRE): "Observability looks sufficient; add alert for high affine_merge_fallback_count."
- Author: "Alert added to redwood/observability alert deck; linked in rollout notes."

CI summary: Initial CI run had lint + test failures on string formatting (fixed), second run succeeded; perf harness ran in separate workflow and passed internal thresholds. Overall ci_status: pass.

Merge: Squash-merged after approvals. Merge method: squash.

Rollout plan: Canary on dedicated capacity pools (10% traffic) for 48h, monitor prefetch_window_misses, affine_merge_fallback_count, P95 latency, and output diff regression on eval set. If fallback_count > 100 in 48h or P95 degrades by >10% revert.

Risks & mitigations: The main risk is register pressure causing slowdowns on older GPUs; mitigated via runtime heuristics that lower vector width and fall back to the safe path. Another risk is KV-prefetch misalignment under unpredictable request interleaving; the scheduler keeps a small conservative backoff and exposes tuning params for platform teams.

Related: references Linear ENG-4821 (design), ENG-4906 (perf harness), and prior PR pr-370456 (hierarchical-dequant-kv-prefetch-adapter) for historical context.
release_notes: Improves INT8/FP8 hybrid path latency and P95; introduces affine_merge kernel and KV prefetch scheduler; opt-in via runtime flags; canary rollout recommended.
